login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your cameras.

setup.title: Welcome to Little Sister
setup.intro: Three short steps and you are ready.
setup.stepAccountText: You will use this account to manage cameras and users.
setup.stepStorageText: Little Sister stores recordings here. Pick a folder on a large disk.
setup.stepRegionText: Recordings are stored in UTC and shown in your time zone.
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long sentence beats a short word.

home.camerasText: Add your first camera. Little Sister can find it on your network automatically.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Administrators can do everything, viewers can only watch and download.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached right now.
errors.invalidCredentials: User name or password is wrong.
errors.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for a few minutes.
errors.http429: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.absolutePathRequired: Please enter a full path, e.g. /recordings or D:\Recordings.
errors.notWritable: Little Sister may not write to this folder.
errors.PasswordTooShort: The password is too short (at least 10 characters).
errors.InvalidUserName: The user name contains invalid characters.
errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.setupAlreadyCompleted: Little Sister is already set up.
errors.rtspUrlRequired: Please enter an RTSP address, e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/stream.
errors.onvifUnauthorized: The camera rejected user name or password.
errors.onvifUnreachable: The camera cannot be reached at this address.
errors.onvifInvalidResponse: The camera does not answer like an ONVIF device.
errors.streamNotFound: There is no stream at this address.
errors.streamRefused: The camera refuses RTSP connections. Is RTSP switched on?
errors.streamTimeout: The camera does not answer in time.
errors.ffprobeMissing: ffprobe is not installed on the server.
errors.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg is not installed on the server.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.noRecordings: There are no recordings in this period.
errors.motionNeedsOnvif: Motion events from the camera need its ONVIF address.
errors.invalidZones: At least one cell must be monitored.
errors.outOfRange: The value is out of the allowed range.
errors.onvifNoEvents: Little Sister cannot find an ONVIF event service on this camera. The camera’s answer is in the log.
errors.eventsFailed: Motion detection failed. See the log for details.
errors.onvifNoEventSubscription: The camera rejects both kinds of event subscription (PullPoint and Subscribe). See the log for details.
errors.eventsCallbackLocalhost: The camera sends its events itself but cannot reach Little Sister, which only listens on localhost. Listen on 0.0.0.0 or set LittleSister__Events__CallbackUrl.
errors.eventsCallbackUnavailable: Little Sister has no address the camera could deliver its events to. Please set LittleSister__Events__CallbackUrl.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.subtitle: All connected cameras with recording status and storage use.
cameras.storageDaysUnknown: Duration is calculated after the first recordings
cameras.noneFoundHint: Check that ONVIF is enabled on the camera. When Little Sister runs in Docker, search only works with host networking. You can also enter the IP address directly.
cameras.enableHint: Tip: many cameras (e.g. Reolink) need RTSP and ONVIF switched on in their network settings first.
cameras.name: Name
cameras.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
cameras.hevcHint: H.265 is recorded without conversion. For the live view, please add an H.264 substream; many browsers cannot play H.265.
cameras.quotaHint: When full, the oldest recordings of this camera are deleted.
cameras.retentionHint: Optional, e.g. for privacy. Older recordings are deleted even if space is left.
cameras.deleteRecordings: Also delete all recordings of this camera?
cameras.wipeHint: Deletes all recordings and motion events of this camera. The camera stays set up and keeps recording.
cameras.wipeConfirm: Type the camera name “{name}” to confirm
cameras.wipeDoneSkipped: {count} recording(s) deleted, {skipped} skipped (recordings folder not reachable).
cameras.rotationHint: Clockwise. Only rotates the display, at no processing cost; recordings are rotated during playback.
cameras.modeMotionHint: Records only when something moves in the image.
cameras.detectionVideoHint: Little Sister compares the frames of the substream. Works with any camera and needs little processing time.
cameras.detectionOnvifHint: The camera reports motion itself. Detection is configured in the camera; not every camera does this reliably.
cameras.sensitivityHint: Higher = even small movements count. Lower it on false alarms (leaves, rain).
cameras.zonesHint: Advanced: paint the cells where motion counts. Everything else (e.g. street, tree) is ignored.
cameras.zonesNeedUrl: Enter the stream address first, then the camera image appears here.
cameras.zonesNoImage: No camera image: {reason} Cells can still be set.
cameras.onvifAddressHint: The camera reports motion through this address, e.g. http://192.168.0.160:8080. IP and port are enough, the path is added. Filled in automatically by the search.
cameras.preRollHint: Kept from before the motion. The stream then runs constantly into a short buffer. With 0, recording starts with the motion.
cameras.postRollHint: Recording continues this long after the motion ends.

storage.title: Storage
storage.minFreeHint: Below this, Little Sister deletes the oldest recordings of all cameras.
storage.pathHint: Little Sister stores new recordings here.
storage.pathChangeHint: New recordings go to the new folder. Existing ones stay in the previous folder and are still managed and deleted there.
storage.thumbnailsHint: After each recording a strip of images is created (one every 10 seconds). This takes some CPU time; when switched off, no new images are created.

live.go2rtcMissing: Live view is unavailable: go2rtc was not found. Recording continues anyway.
live.go2rtcFailed: Live view is currently disrupted and restarting. Recording continues anyway.

playback.title: Recordings
playback.noRecordings: There are no recordings on this day.
playback.failed: This browser cannot play the recording.
playback.exportHint: Mark the period on the timeline by dragging, or set start and end at the playback position. The export begins at the preceding keyframe, so up to a few seconds earlier.
playback.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
playback.timelineHelp: Click to jump · drag to mark for export · wheel zooms · drag the scale to pan
playback.timelineHelpTouch: Tap to jump · drag to mark for export · drag the scale to pan
